title: Old Tweedy
html_source: Molly (Bloom’s wife) was born in Gibraltar in 1870 to Major Tweedy and Lunita Laredo. Major Tweedy was an Irish military officer stationed on Gibraltar with the British army – he may or may not have been married to Lunita.
